prompt:
Rewrite snippets/free-shipping-progress.liquid so it renders an accessible free-shipping progress bar with a safely escaped label. Inputs (all top-level; there is no section object): - `total_cents`: integer >= 0. This is the cart total in cents. - `threshold_cents`: integer or null. This is the free-shipping threshold in cents. - `currency`: string, never null. It is a currency prefix such as "$", and it may contain characters like < > &. - `remaining_template`: string or null. It is merchant text in which every occurrence of the literal placeholder `[amount]` is replaced with the formatted remaining amount. - `success_text`: string or null. Rules: 1. If `threshold_cents` is null, or is <= 0, output nothing (an empty string). 2. percent = (total_cents * 100) integer-divided by threshold_cents, rounded down. Cap it at 100 when it exceeds 100. Examples: 4995 of 5000 gives 99, and 1999 of 2000 gives 99. 3. remaining = threshold_cents - total_cents. 4. If remaining > 0, build the message: - Format the amount as currency + whole units + "." + cents padded to exactly two digits. For example, 5 cents gives "$0.05", 1205 gives "$12.05" and 1000 gives "$10.00". - Strip `remaining_template`. If it is null or empty after stripping, use the default "Add [amount] for free shipping". - Replace every `[amount]` in that template with the formatted amount, using the raw, unescaped amount. 5. If remaining <= 0, the message is `success_text` after stripping. If it is null or empty after stripping, use the default "Free shipping unlocked!". 6. The final message is HTML-escaped exactly once, as a whole, after the placeholder substitution: & < > " become & < > ". This includes any characters coming from the currency. Do not double-escape. Output is a single line with no whitespace between tags. N is the percent and L is the escaped message: `

L

` Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/free-shipping-progress.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
